config.question: when a comparison group contains exactly one bold cell, is that cell the best value in the group
config.sample: 1631 papers extracted so far, 17373 single-bold groups

notes: In 22 percent of groups the bolded cell is not the best value, which we read as authors marking their own method rather than a winner. Those groups are discarded, and the discard rate belongs in the paper: it says the analysed set is the set of claimed wins, not of all highlighted cells.
